criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official Purdue GIS feature 432 (DUDL, Dudley Hall); saved validation reports symmetric nearest-vertex error 0.0001 m. GIS attributes identify the hall, while the footprint is horizontal only and not a certified survey.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Manifest defines direct campus-world coordinates with identity transform. Exact ring correspondence preserves placement and orientation; GIS minimum-rotated-rectangle dimensions are 97.18 x 32.17 m at 0.172° east of north. The metric frame is the project’s approximate geographic conversion, not survey control.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue’s archived 2019 announcement identifies four stories plus a basement, which supports four visible above-grade bands. The saved model is 16.0 m tall and the flat parapet roof is visually plausible, but height, roof elevation, and basement depth have no measured source; GIS explicitly marks height unverified.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Direct visual review of the saved preview shows brick-colored walls, repeated dark window bands, a glazed entrance treatment, a pale facade cue, and a terracotta-colored screen. These cues appear in the saved Ennead photograph, but that photograph shows both Dudley and Lambertus; assigning these elements to Dudley’s polygon and fixing their exact positions is schematic. The preview is a single oblique view and does not independently establish facade orientation or detail accuracy.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Saved asset exists at the manifest path; retained Blender reopen record names collection Asset_dudley_hall and 6 meshes. Builder generates geometry/materials internally without external texture paths. Source records include provider, URL, feature/date, CRS or applicability, method, and uncertainty; preview and raw source snapshots exist (4/4 source files).

findings: The official GIS outline verifies horizontal plan agreement only; it does not verify facade offsets, height, roof elevation, or basement depth.
The model’s 16.0 m height is an estimate. Four stories are sourced, but the floor-to-floor dimensions are not.
The Ennead exterior image depicts the combined Dudley–Lambertus complex; facade assignment to Dudley and screen placement remain uncertain.
The saved preview supports only a schematic architectural resemblance and does not resolve the combined-hall attribution uncertainty.
method_note: Independent assessment used direct visual comparison of the saved preview against the retained original source image, and read the raw GIS/source snapshots and saved-asset Blender reopen record. No builder or geometry was modified.
